q1_issues.issue: (LocatedIn sk_lanterns_1 sunken_cove) asserts a containment the text never states — 'the Sunken Cove lanterns' only identifies which lanterns — and the instruction set explicitly bars an unstated location link however obvious.

'the Keepers' is a definite plural group with a distributive predicate ('tend'), yet only the group event is emitted and the per-member PartOf rule the instruction set requires for a distributive predicate over a group is absent, so a named keeper could never be shown to have tended.

q2_gaps: a proper-noun modifier on a common noun ('the Sunken Cove lanterns'): fusion into a compound kind is barred for proper nouns, and no relation head is specified for attaching the name to the head noun, so nothing licensed encodes the modification

a bare season name as a time filler ('in winter'): the instruction set gives structured terms for the calendar granularities and bare symbols only for deictics ('last_spring') and day-parts ('morning'), never for a bare season

a proper name whose name-derived symbol is identical to its own kind lemma ('the Watch' -> (Member watch watch)): the instruction set requires distinct symbols for distinct same-named entities but never says how to keep an individual symbol clear of the class symbol it collides with
a capitalized definite plural naming a group or order ('the Keepers'): the proper-noun and definite-plural rules both apply and the instruction set never says how they combine
whether a per-member distribution rule can or should be nested inside a conditional rule's consequent — the distribution machinery is only stated for a plain clause
notes: The 'when'-clause is correctly a plain Implication with no connective atom, the copular trigger is reified with Experiencer and tied to the consequent by During in the whenever pattern, and the definite referents project at top level while nothing about largeness is asserted. The feather_store genus, the two Name atoms and the 'safely' Manner form are all right.
